name: Blinded Awareness
body:
Without your sight, you grow more aware of the world around you.

Prerequisite(s): Elevated awareness racial trait, character level 9th.

Benefit: While your eyes are closed or you are otherwise blinded, the range of your blindsense increases to 30 feet and you gain blindsight 15 feet.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
